landscape.label: What You Need to Know
title: Kitchen Remodeling
Contractor
landscape.say: Planning a kitchen remodel in Santa Clarita? Here's what you need to know before you hire a contractor: the four decisions that shape your project, what a kitchen remodel costs in 2026, the common questions homeowners ask, and how to pick the right contractor.

landscape.label: Before You Start
landscape.title: 4 things to know before you start

cards.name: Layout matters most
cards.desc: A poor layout makes even a brand-new kitchen frustrating

cards.name: Moving plumbing costs more
cards.desc: Keep the sink & dishwasher where they are to control your budget

cards.name: Lighting changes everything
cards.desc: Under-cabinet, task & overhead lighting all play a role

cards.name: Materials drive the budget
cards.desc: Cabinets, counters, floors & finishes set the total cost

landscape.say: Four things to know before you start. First, layout matters more than anything: a poor layout can make even a brand-new kitchen frustrating to use. Second, moving plumbing increases cost, so keeping your sink and dishwasher where they are controls your budget. Third, lighting affects both function and appearance, from under-cabinet to overhead lights. And fourth, your materials drive the budget: cabinets, countertops, flooring, and finishes.

landscape.label: 2026 Price Ranges
landscape.title: What a Santa Clarita kitchen remodel costs
landscape.sub: 2026 ranges · depending on size and scope
landscape.speak: So what does it cost? A basic kitchen remodel runs about forty-five to fifty-five thousand dollars and up. An in-depth kitchen makeover runs about fifty-five to seventy-five thousand dollars and up. And a luxury kitchen runs seventy-five thousand to one hundred fifty thousand dollars and up, depending on size and scope.

landscape.label: What a Contractor Handles
landscape.title: What a full-service contractor handles
landscape.note: Plus electrical & plumbing upgrades, tile backsplashes & under-cabinet lighting.
landscape.say: A full-service contractor should handle the whole job: layout and kitchen design, open-concept kitchens, quartz and granite countertops, new and custom cabinets, storage solutions, new flooring, kitchen islands, and bars and seating. Plus electrical and plumbing upgrades, tile backsplashes, and under-cabinet lighting.

landscape.label: Common Questions
landscape.title: Common questions, answered

cards.name: How long does it take?
cards.desc: A few weeks for a minor remodel; a few months for a full renovation

cards.name: Do I need a permit?
cards.desc: Most major remodels do. Your contractor should pull it

cards.name: Can I live at home?
cards.desc: Yes, often with a temporary setup for water & appliances

landscape.say: Here are the questions homeowners ask most. How long does it take? A minor remodel might take a few weeks, and a full renovation a few months. Do I need a permit? Most major kitchen remodels do, and your contractor should handle it. Can I live at home during the remodel? Yes, often with a temporary setup for water and appliances. And how can I save? Choose budget-friendly materials, and keep your layout.

landscape.label: How to Pick a Contractor
landscape.title: How to pick a kitchen contractor
landscape.note: Settle layout changes early: changing it mid-project means change orders & delays.
landscape.say: When you pick a contractor, look for a California license you can verify, and make sure they're bonded and insured. They should pull permits and handle code compliance, give you written estimates and clear timelines, handle both design and build, and know Santa Clarita's building department. And settle any layout changes early, because changing it mid-project means change orders and delays.
